requests.title: Accept the interface-first ordering changes of the v4.1 DAG
requests.question: v4.1 lets the interface freeze (T14) start before the kernel (T13) and the invariant tests (T12), and the save machine (T19) and GitHub provider (T20) start before the kernel, because the frozen contracts fix the types. It keeps the invariant tests before the save machine (T12 before T19, R4-01) and the kernel before integration checkpoint 1 (T13 before T17) and before live integration (T13 before T21). It also keeps the invariant tests before review checkpoint T35. The five v4 orderings it drops are listed with reasons in analysis/task-adjustments.json waivedPrecedences: T12 before T14, T13 before T14, T13 before T19, T13 before T20, T13 before T35. Dropping T13 before T14, T19 and T20 sets aside KICKOFF-EXECUTION-PACKET §4 ('parallel ownership after the kernel stabilizes'), which T14 covers; it depends on ODR-V41-06. Accept them?
options: A: accept the ordering changes
B: keep v4's orderings
requests.recommendation: A, if ODR-V41-06 is A. With v4's estimates, the ordering changes alone shorten the dependency critical path from 340 to 305 minutes and topology C's total from 405 to 395 (schedule.json scenarios). Topology A does not fit the 420-minute window in any scenario; C fits in every scenario.
requests.rationale: The change moves integration risk from T19 to T21 (optimization-report.md, risks R41-02 and R41-03); the owner decides whether that trade is acceptable.
requests.impact: With B, the agent removes the dependency changes from task-adjustments.json and recompiles; the other v4.1 artifacts still apply.

requests.title: Organizer-approval obligations for November 7
requests.question: The assignment removes every internal workflow gate that waits on organizers (OD-INDY-18), but the frozen v4 baseline and its source documents still tie parts of the plan to organizer approval or organizer rules. These are: ADRP-016-O2 (must: 'Prepared requirements, library capabilities, design guidance, frozen fixtures, and scripts are subject to organizer approval; do not transfer a prebuilt competition app where prohibited', both clauses) and its readiness-checklist form; STORAGE-008-O1 and CAUSA-DATA-CONTRACT-v1 §10.8 (organizer permission for the pre-created dataset and executable schemas); R0.1-O1 (must: source implementation begins at kickoff 'from a blank application repository or the organizer-approved equivalent') and the kickoff packet's 'empty/organizer-compliant' checks; DOMAIN-TEST-MATRIX §29 and PRODUCT-REQUIREMENTS (executable tests before kickoff only if organizer rules permit; at T0 the bootstrap writes the pre-written executable layout-assertion module, tests/browser/support/layout-assertions.mjs); the preflight check PRE-ORG-01 (task T06, gate G0) and v4's risk RISK-12; OD-INDY-12 (interfaces 'only after the organizer confirms'); and ODR-V41-06, whose record states an organizer confirmation and which set aside REHEARSAL-AGENT-INTERFACE-FREEZE's clause that F# signatures 'MUST be authored from the requirements at kickoff' — the basis of the pre-authored contracts and of the four contract-first waivers (T12>T14, T13>T14, T13>T19, T13>T20). No agent may weaken a requirement, claim one met, or decide this. How are they handled for November 7?
options: A: proceed without seeking organizer approval. Every obligation listed stays unchanged in the frozen baseline. The organizer-approval obligations (ADRP-016-O2, its checklist form, STORAGE-008-O1, PRE-ORG-01) are reported as not met at G0 and G10, with OD-INDY-18 as the reason. R0.1-O1, the kickoff checks and the DOMAIN-TEST-MATRIX condition are verified by their own obligations at acceptance and reported as their evidence shows, not presumed met. RISK-12 is accepted. OD-INDY-12's condition does not apply to the v4.1.1 contracts, which are authored from the requirements, not extracted from earlier rehearsals (X11). ODR-V41-06's set-aside, and the contract-first waivers resting on it, stand as the owner recorded them. No task waits on any of this.
B: keep the organizer gate. T10 waits for an organizer record under PRE-ORG-01; v4.1.1 withdraws change V411-C and keeps the rest.

C: ask the organizers, but do not wait. The question is sent before the event; any answer is recorded under PRE-ORG-01; each obligation is reported met or not met by that answer and its own evidence; no task waits on it.
requests.recommendation: The owner's call. A follows the assignment's instruction ('We are not requesting organizer approval for the engineering process') and reports the unmet obligations honestly instead of claiming them; C keeps the same schedule and may close them.
requests.rationale: A must obligation of the frozen baseline conflicts with the owner's instruction to remove organizer gates. The agent may not set a requirement aside (RDP-003); only the owner decides.
requests.impact: Until it is decided, owner-freeze.fsx approve v4.1.1 refuses to record the package approval. X19 lists every organizer reference the scan finds, each with a disposition under ODR-V411-02 or, where nothing is decided, OD-INDY-18.

requests.title: Rate-limit user- and network-driven reconciliation reads to INV-04 (Rehearsal 8 DEV-R8-11)
requests.question: INV-04 allows at most four reconciliation reads in 60 s under total network failure, but SM-SAVE T-S31 (Check again) and T-S32 (back online) each send a read with no limit, so the frozen tables contradict the invariant (Rehearsal 8 DEV-R8-11; percepta spec-preflight rate-bound-vs-unbounded-loop). How do the transitions keep within INV-04?
options: A: rate-limit to INV-04's own numbers: replace T-S31 (UnknownOutcome + CheckAgain -> UnknownOutcome, automatic reads spent and fewer than four reconciliation reads sent in the 60 s before RequestContext.Now: one read) and T-S32 (UnknownOutcome + WentOnline -> UnknownOutcome, fewer than four reads sent in that window: one read); add T-S62 (UnknownOutcome + CheckAgain -> UnknownOutcome at four reads: send nothing, keep Check again offered and announce when it reads again) and T-S63 (UnknownOutcome + WentOnline -> UnknownOutcome at four reads: send nothing, offer Check again); add RequestContext.Now and InvestigationSession.ReconcileReadsSentAt (IF41-WIRE, IF41-SAVE)
B: amend INV-04 to count only automatic reads (a requirement change, not in v4.1.2)
C: leave the contradiction; INV04 RequestBounds stays red
requests.recommendation: A. It uses INV-04's own numbers, so no requirement changes; the clock enters through RequestContext and the machines stay pure.
requests.rationale: Owner choice given 2026-11-02: rate limit, INV-04's own numbers.
requests.impact: Until recorded, v4.1.2 cannot be compiled with these transitions (ownerRecords).

requests.title: Give CommandEnvelope its command and EventPayload its event body (Rehearsal 8 DEV-R8-09, CR-T17-01)
requests.question: The frozen CommandEnvelope stub holds only identities and a version, and EventPayload only a kind string, though FSHARP-TYPE-SHAPES sections 31-33 specify CommandEnvelope.Command : Command and EventPayload = CoreEvent | ExtensionEvent. Decide cannot tell the 134 catalog commands apart and replay cannot rebuild an investigation. Restore them?
options: A: restore sections 31-33 in 00-DOMAIN-STUBS.fs: Command = Core of CoreCommand (its 29 case names) | Extension of SemanticId * payloadJson; EventPayload = CoreEvent of CoreEvent (its 28 case names) | ExtensionEvent of SemanticId * payloadJson; CommandEnvelope gains Command: Command; each payload type is opaque in the stub and defined by the domain owner
B: restore the full payload shapes of sections 31-33
C: keep the abbreviated stubs
requests.recommendation: A. It restores the specified boundary without freezing about 20 payload records into the contract.
requests.rationale: Owner choice given 2026-11-02: add the command field, section-31 case names with opaque payloads, and the same treatment for events.
requests.impact: Until recorded, the v4.1.2 contract changes cannot pass X17.

requests.title: State the failed final automatic reconciliation read (Rehearsal 8 DEV-R8-12)
requests.question: SM-SAVE defines (UnknownOutcome, ReconcileReadFailed) only while fewer than three automatic reads were made; when the third read fails the step fails closed with a request outstanding and the session cannot progress (Rehearsal 8 DEV-R8-12). Which transition applies?
options: A: add T-S64 (UnknownOutcome + ReconcileReadFailed -> UnknownOutcome, three automatic reads already made): offer Check again, nothing outstanding, no further automatic reads except one per offline-to-online change (T-S30's effects, as Rehearsal 8 ratified)
B: leave the pair fail-closed
requests.recommendation: A. The fail-safe reading Rehearsal 8 ratified: no write, no guess, a user-driven retry.
requests.rationale: Owner choice given 2026-11-02: write it to the table.
